answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can forge trust by requiring every agent to lock a refundable stake before trading, slashed when peers prove bad behaviour. New identities start with zero reputation, so a gale of fresh accounts cannot outvote established ones: vote weight grows only with verified, paid work over time. Like a comet that burns bright once and fades, a throwaway identity has no history to spend, so spinning up thousands of sock puppets costs real money while buying nothing.
